# Issue 4629. The reporter filed `-T ps_6_5 -E PSMain -HV 2021`, preserved
# verbatim in cmd-as-filed.txt. This differs from it in two ways, both measured
# rather than assumed, because targeting the newest profile and flag set the
# reporter happened to use is what silently shortens a release history:
#
#   -HV 2021 dropped   `Unknown HLSL version: 2021` makes every release before
#                      HLSL 2021 shipped an invalid-probe, so keeping it would
#                      throw away the oldest end of the history.
#   ps_6_5 -> ps_6_0   ps_6_0 is expressible by every release back to the
#                      v1.4.1907 bisection floor.
#
# Equivalence evidence, all on the ground-truth build and all in this directory:
#   variant-hv-default-*    -T ps_6_5 -E PSMain           -> repro, 0x80000003
#   variant-ps60-hv2021-*   -T ps_6_0 -E PSMain -HV 2021  -> repro, 0x80000003
#   variant-ps60-default-*  -T ps_6_0 -E PSMain           -> repro, 0x80000003
#   manual-case-widened-stack.txt  same DXASSERT, same file:line, byte-identical
#                                  frame offsets as the as-filed command line
#
# measure-history.py additionally runs the as-filed command against every
# release, so nothing rests on the widening holding across releases either.
-T ps_6_0 -E PSMain repro.hlsl
